units: <cite ref="Zevachim 62a:8">Zeb. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>קרן … ור׳ מעכבין</he> the horn, the ascent, the foundation, and the square shape are indispensable conditions for the altar.
Ib. 108ᵇ; a. fr.—ר׳ עולם the cardinal points of the world.

<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 6:14">Tosef. Erub. VI (V), 3; Erub. 56</cite><cite ref="Eruvin 56a:4">Erub. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>בא לרבעה מרבעה בר׳ ע׳ וכ׳</he> when you square a town (for Sabbath limits, v. <cite ref="T00128"><he>רָבַע</he></cite>), you must square it in accordance with the cardinal points, and the marks are Charles’s Wain in the north &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 56a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אם אינו … בר׳ וכ׳</he> if you do not know how to square it in accordance with the cardinal points &c.; a. e.
